Principle 11: Single Life vs. Married Life
After Graduating College
Most Korean people don’t really go into the same field they major in at university.
This was the same for me.
I changed jobs many times, before I started my current job as an automobile engineer.
I have learned so much over the years at this job.
I found that what I learned during college about engineering and what my job was like was really different.
It seemed like I had to start over and relearn everything again.
I really value what I have learned about teamwork and how everyone needs to be diligent in their job for everyone to succeed.
Dating the Right One
My co-workers introduced me to my girlfriend, who is now my wife.
I wanted to get married later in life, but when I first met my wife, it was love at first sight.
I felt like I had known her for a long time even though we just met.
We had many of the same interests and tastes.
On weekends, we traveled a lot, and we always had a great time.
Our love became progressively stronger as time passed.
Marrying Mr. or Miss Right
After dating for three years, we got married.
I had not saved much money, so when we were first married, life was difficult for us.
My wife never complained, and she was always supportive of me.
When I think back on my wedding, I will always remember how beautiful and special it was.
